purpose: Freeze the verified HeroFetter ConditionType=2 required-Hero resolver without declaring the whole Stage 5-1 page block complete.

verifiedRule.missionStageJoin: When MissionInfo.Param2 == 6, MissionInfo.Param3 -> ConfigDataHeroDungeonLevelInfo.ID; the stage owner Hero is derived by reverse-indexing ConfigDataHeroInformationInfo.DungeonLevels_ID[].
verifiedRule.candidateResolver: canonical(MissionInfo.Param1) UNION canonical(HeroInformationInfo.ID that reverse-owns MissionInfo.Param3 via DungeonLevels_ID[]) MINUS FetterOwnerHeroId
verifiedRule.requiredHeroResolver: the sole remaining canonical Hero candidate
verifiedRule.importantOrientationRule: MissionInfo.Param1 is not always the required Hero and the Param3 stage owner is not always the required Hero; either side can be the Fetter owner. Resolve by set subtraction against the Fetter owner.
verifiedRule.otherCanonicalType2Rows: MissionType 5/Param2 2 or 5, MissionType 29, and MissionType 34 do not produce an external required-Hero edge in the verified canonical scope.

decision.reasonStageNotComplete: The resolver semantics are frozen, but the production Hero bond block/schema and final Stage 5-1 validation output have not yet been generated from this rule.
decision.nextStartPoint: Build a dedicated Stage 5-1 production consumer that preserves HeroFetter data, resolves ConditionType=2 missions with this rule, emits one Hero-keyed bond block for all 267 canonical Heroes, and then freeze hero-page-stage5-1-final.v1.json.
